column1: Saltillo on the mares we stole bound for who knows where
Crossing the river waist high in the water lit by the cigarettes glare
We lost one man he reeled and he crumbled by my side
Put the wounds to the fire to cauterize the bleeding for the night
I saw a flying machine crash in burning water
And the word pistola painted on the sun
Boxed in against the mesa holding an empty .44 gun
Sangre sobre las cabezas los dios canta triste canción
Standing before the firing squad smoking our last cigars
A lesson learned a stolen horse won’t get you far
